_about: Plan 07 measure-only clip smoke set. Two kinds of clip: `sample` (CC0 clips of namnq/workout-free-videos, tag v2.0.0, looped `loops` times and re-encoded all-intra because the source has a single keyframe and the iOS frame extractor snaps to keyframes) and `owner_recording` (a long real workout filmed by the project owner, kept OUT of the repo: only its source link, byte size and SHA-256 are stored; CI downloads it, verifies the hash and re-encodes it all-intra at the replay sampling rate, `transcode`). Nothing here is a baseline for the three reference videos (video_ground_truth.json) and no job fails on a count. Ground truth is counted by eye; `human_reviewed` says whether a person has checked it.

clip-pull-up-l02.view: from behind, whole body, landscape 1280x720, slow camera drift
clip-pull-up-l02.notes: One full rep per loop: dead hang at 0 s, chin at the bar about 3 s, back to a full hang by 5.8 s. The loop seam is at the hang, so looping adds no partial rep.

clip-curl-b01.view: from the front, whole body, landscape 1280x720, slow camera orbit; barbell, not dumbbells
clip-curl-b01.notes: One full rep per loop: arms extended at 0 s, bar at the shoulders about 3-4 s, extended again by 8 s. The loop seam is at full extension.

clip-real-curl-img0967.video: iPhone QuickTime MOV, H.264 1920x1080 with 90-degree rotation (portrait 1080x1920), ~60 fps, AAC audio
clip-real-curl-img0967.view: from the front, portrait; phone low on the floor about 2 m away, looking slightly up. Standing sets: head (top of frame) to mid-shin; dumbbells at the hips sit near the left and right frame edges, the curled dumbbell rises to the face. Between sets the owner walks out, sits side-on on a chair in the background, kneels with the back to the camera or stretches; the clip starts and ends on a torso close-up while the phone is handled.
clip-real-curl-img0967.counted_by: eye (Claude), 2 fps contact sheets with a 10 fps dark-blob motion trace as a pointer; timestamps +-0.5 s
clip-real-curl-img0967.rep_unit: one single-arm curl: alternating dumbbell curls, and the app counts each arm (TwoArmMerger merges only both arms within 400 ms)

sets.notes: Video opens on a close-up of the torso (owner adjusting the phone, 0-2 s), walks back and picks up the dumbbells at 3-4 s, stands still holding them 5-13 s.
Gets up from the chair at 231 s, crouches to pick up the dumbbells 233-234 s.
Enters side-on very close to the phone (431-434 s, head and arm cut by the frame edge), picks up at 435-436 s.
At 682 s both dumbbells swing up part-way while setting them down: not counted.

clip-real-curl-img0967.notes: Long real workout: 4 sets of alternating dumbbell curls separated by 2.5-3 min of rest. image_left/image_right are sides of the picture, not the lifter's arms. Rest windows include arm movements that are not curls (hand to the head while seated ~80-88 s, overhead stretch ~540 s).
